stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure17.gif##

figureAlts.figure17.gif: The image describes a results table with 20,000 rows from 10,000 simulations. It has two columns: Competitor, which is a string indicating the name of the competitor (either "tortoise" or "hare"), and Distance, which is an integer representing the final distance of the competitor at the end of the race. Part (d) instructs to use the results table to create an overlaid histogram showing the distribution of final distances for both the tortoise and the hare. Below this, there is a code snippet with four blanks labeled Blank 1, Blank 2, Blank 3, and Blank 4.
